newsitem.title: GERMANY: Munich Re - 96/97 div increase not ruled out.
newsitem.headline: Munich Re - 96/97 div increase not ruled out.

text.p: The Munich-based reinsurance company Munich Re AG said on Monday it did not completely rule out a dividend increase in 1996/97.
"I cannot completely rule out the possibility of the dividend being raised again in the next year," Munich Re's management board chairman Juergen Schnitzler told a news conference.
Schnitzler said that dividends for the year to the end of 1996/97 would not be lower, "unless something goes spectacularly wrong."
Munich Re, the world's largest reinsurer, increased its dividend for the fourth time in a row in 1995/96 and is proposing a payout of 16 marks per share, up from 13.50 marks per share last time.
